_comment: Frozen contract for the agent families whose wakes are handed over while the
agent is `working`, as a follow-up in the chat it has open, rather than held
until it is idle. A Cursor chat stays `working` for the whole conversation, so
holding for idle would hold its Channel mentions for good; Claude Code and the
rest go idle between turns and keep the hold.
The hub reads the manifest's `adapter` (or `framework`) against `adapters`
each kind with `wakes_while_working` and records it under its manifest family
